'''Kraff''' was, according to the [[Epsilon Program]] and its founder [[Cris Formage]], the Emperor of the 4th Paradigm and appears to be a key part of the cults beliefs. The Epsilon Program's website says that anybody with a birth mark may be a descendent of Kraff.
